create_attribute.name: create_attribute
create_attribute.description: This tool creates a new custom attribute in a Personalize project, defining user characteristics for audience segmentation and content personalization targeting.

name.description: Name for the attribute (maximum 200 characters, must be unique)

key.description: Literal key identifier for accessing the attribute value from user profiles

description.description: Description explaining the purpose and usage of this attribute

get_all_attributes.name: get_all_attributes
get_all_attributes.description: This tool retrieves all custom and preset attributes available in a Personalize project for user segmentation and targeting analysis.

update_attribute.name: update_attribute
update_attribute.description: This tool modifies an existing attribute's properties in a Personalize project, allowing updates to name, key, or description fields.

attribute_uid.description: Unique identifier of the attribute to be updated.

name.description: Name for the attribute (maximum 200 characters, must be unique)

key.description: Literal key identifier for accessing the attribute value from user profiles

description.description: Description explaining the purpose and usage of this attribute

delete_attribute.name: delete_attribute
delete_attribute.description: This tool permanently removes an attribute from a Personalize project, ensuring cleanup of unused user characteristics from segmentation.

attribute_uid.description: Unique identifier of the attribute to be deleted.

get_all_audiences.name: get_all_audiences
get_all_audiences.description: This tool retrieves all audience segments from a Personalize project, with optional filtering by referenced attributes for targeted analysis.

includeLyticsAudiences.description: Optional flag to include Lytics audiences in the results

referredAttributes.description: Optional filter to return audiences referencing specific attribute UIDs

delete_audience.name: delete_audience
delete_audience.description: This tool permanently removes an audience segment from a Personalize project, cleaning up unused targeting definitions.

audience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the audience to be deleted.

create_experience.name: create_experience
create_experience.description: This tool creates a new personalization experience (Segmented or A/B Test) in a Personalize project, automatically generating a draft version for configuration.

description.description: Description explaining the experience purpose and goals

__type.description: Type of experience: SEGMENTED for audience-based content or AB_TEST for conversion optimization

get_all_experiences.name: get_all_experiences
get_all_experiences.description: This tool retrieves all personalization experiences from a Personalize project, with optional filtering by referenced audiences or events for analysis.

referredEvents.description: Optional filter to return experiences referencing specific event UIDs as metrics

referredAudiences.description: Optional filter to return experiences referencing specific audience UIDs in variants or targeting

get_single_experience.name: get_single_experience
get_single_experience.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific personalization experience from a Personalize project, including its current configuration and status.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to retrieve.

update_experience.name: update_experience
update_experience.description: This tool modifies an existing experience's metadata in a Personalize project, allowing updates to name and description but not type conversion.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to be updated.

__type.description: Experience type (cannot be changed after creation)

delete_experience.name: delete_experience
delete_experience.description: This tool permanently removes a personalization experience from a Personalize project, including all associated versions and configurations.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to be deleted.

get_experience_versions.name: get_experience_versions
get_experience_versions.description: This tool retrieves all versions of a specific experience from a Personalize project, sorted by creation date for version history analysis.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to fetch versions for.

delete_experience_version.name: delete_experience_version
delete_experience_version.description: This tool discards a draft version of an experience in a Personalize project, deletion of active, paused, or archived versions is not allowed.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience containing the version.

version_uid.description: Unique identifier of the draft version to be deleted.

get_experiences_priority.name: get_experiences_priority
get_experiences_priority.description: This tool retrieves the priority order configuration for all experiences in a Personalize project, determining content display precedence.

update_experiences_priority.name: update_experiences_priority
update_experiences_priority.description: This tool modifies the priority order of experiences in a Personalize project, controlling which experience displays when multiple target the same content area.

priorityOrder.description: Array of experience UIDs in descending priority order (highest priority first)

create_event.name: create_event
create_event.description: This tool creates a new event definition in a Personalize project for tracking user interactions and measuring experience performance metrics.

key.description: Unique key identifier for the event (used in API calls and SDK)

description.description: Description explaining the event purpose and when it should be triggered

get_all_events.name: get_all_events
get_all_events.description: This tool retrieves all event definitions from a Personalize project for tracking and analytics configuration review.

update_event.name: update_event
update_event.description: This tool modifies an existing event definition in a Personalize project, allowing updates to the key identifier and description.

event_uid.description: Unique identifier of the event to be updated.

key.description: Updated key identifier for the event

delete_event.name: delete_event
delete_event.description: This tool permanently removes an event definition from a Personalize project, cleaning up unused tracking configurations.

event_uid.description: Unique identifier of the event to be deleted.

get_analytics_summary.name: get_analytics_summary
get_analytics_summary.description: This tool retrieves performance analytics summary for a specific experience version, including impressions, conversions, and probability-to-be-best calculations for optimization insights.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to fetch analytics for.

version_uid.description: Required version UID to filter analytics to a specific experience version.

from_date.description: Optional start date for analytics summary in ISO-8601 format (defaults to experiment beginning). Example: 2024-04-08T00:00:00Z

to_date.description: Optional end date for analytics summary in ISO-8601 format (defaults to present date). Example: 2024-05-30T23:59:59Z

get_analytics_timeseries.name: get_analytics_timeseries
get_analytics_timeseries.description: This tool retrieves hourly time-series analytics data for a specific experience version, providing detailed performance trends over time for optimization analysis.

experience_uid.description: Unique identifier of the experience to fetch analytics for.

version_uid.description: Required version UID to filter analytics to a specific experience version.

from_date.description: Optional start date for analytics data in ISO-8601 format (defaults to experiment beginning). Example: 2024-04-08T00:00:00Z

to_date.description: Optional end date for analytics data in ISO-8601 format (defaults to present date). Example: 2024-05-30T23:59:59Z

metric_key.description: Optional metric filter for A/B test analytics, showing data for a specific event metric

get_countries.name: get_countries
get_countries.description: This tool retrieves country information based on ISO 3166-1 standard for geographic targeting in Personalize audience definitions and segmentation.

skip.description: Number of countries to skip for pagination (works with limit parameter)

limit.description: Maximum number of countries to return (1-1000, default is 10)

country_codes.description: Filter by country codes based on ISO 3166-1 standard (case sensitive)

country_name.description: Filter countries by name matching the provided value

get_regions.name: get_regions
get_regions.description: This tool retrieves region information based on ISO 3166-2 standard for geographic targeting in Personalize audience definitions and state-level segmentation.

skip.description: Number of regions to skip for pagination (works with limit parameter)

limit.description: Maximum number of regions to return (1-1000, default is 10)

region_codes.description: Filter by region codes based on ISO 3166-2 standard (case sensitive)

region_name.description: Filter regions by name matching the provided value

get_cities.name: get_cities
get_cities.description: This tool retrieves city information for geographic targeting in Personalize audience definitions and local-level content personalization.

skip.description: Number of cities to skip for pagination (works with limit parameter)

limit.description: Maximum number of cities to return (1-1000, default is 10)

city_name.description: Filter cities by name matching the provided value
